title: Village Herbal Leaf Identification Guide
problem: Children step on useful medicinal plants like Tulsi, Doddapatre and Neem growing along backyard paths without knowing their health benefits.
idea: Show a leaf to the camera and the screen tells its name and how grandmothers traditionally use it — and warns about poisonous plants. Try it below.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Which leaf does the camera see?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine recognises the leaf. Tap a leaf. (Home remedies are only for small problems. For illness, see a doctor.)
widgets.question: The leaf is:

options.label: Tulsi (Holy basil)
options.result: Tulsi. Traditionally, tulsi leaves are boiled in water or tea to soothe a cough and cold.
options.te: తులసి. దగ్గు, జలుబుకు తులసి ఆకులను నీటిలో మరిగించి తాగుతారు.

options.label: Neem
options.result: Neem. Traditionally, neem leaves are added to bath water, and neem twigs are used to clean teeth.
options.te: వేప. వేప ఆకులు స్నానం నీటిలో వేస్తారు, వేప పుల్లతో పళ్ళు తోముతారు.

options.label: Doddapatre (Karpooravalli)
options.result: Doddapatre. Its thick, sweet-smelling leaves are traditionally used at home for cough and cold.
options.te: కర్పూరవల్లి (వాము ఆకు). దగ్గు, జలుబుకు ఇంట్లో వాడతారు.

options.label: Aloe vera
options.result: Aloe vera. The gel is traditionally put on small burns and dry skin.
options.te: కలబంద. చిన్న కాలిన గాయాలు, పొడి చర్మంపై జెల్ రాస్తారు.

options.label: Datura (Ummetta)
options.result: DANGER! Datura is poisonous. Do not touch, smell or eat it. Wash hands if touched.
options.te: ప్రమాదం! ఉమ్మెత్త విషం. ముట్టుకోవద్దు, తినవద్దు. తాకితే చేతులు కడగండి.

options.label: Jilledu (Calotropis)
options.result: CAREFUL! Its milky sap can hurt your eyes and skin. Do not break the leaves.
options.te: జాగ్రత్త! జిల్లేడు పాలు కళ్ళకు, చర్మానికి హాని. ఆకులు తెంపవద్దు.

items.title: Ask an elder
items.text: Never eat any leaf unless an elder knows it well.
items.te: పెద్దవాళ్ళకు బాగా తెలిసిన ఆకులు తప్ప ఏదీ తినవద్దు.

items.title: Doctor for illness
items.text: Fever for more than 2 days, breathing trouble or bad pain needs a doctor or PHC.
items.te: 2 రోజులకు మించిన జ్వరం, ఊపిరి ఇబ్బందికి డాక్టర్ దగ్గరకు వెళ్ళండి.

items.title: Protect the plants
items.text: Don't step on or pluck too many leaves. Plant a tulsi or neem at home.
items.te: మొక్కలను తొక్కవద్దు. ఇంట్లో తులసి, వేప నాటండి.

questions.why: Datura is poisonous. Never eat it.

questions.q: Neem twigs are traditionally used to…
questions.why: Neem twigs have long been used as a natural toothbrush.

questions.q: You have had high fever for 3 days. What should you do?
options: See a doctor or go to the PHC
questions.why: Home remedies are not enough for long or high fever.

how: With an elder, collect leaves of Tulsi, Neem, Doddapatre and Aloe vera. Learn what Datura and Jilledu look like but don't pluck them — take photos only.
In Teachable Machine (Image Project), make one class per plant. Take about 40 photos of each leaf on a white paper.
Train, Export and open the model in PictoBlox (Scratch blocks).
For each plant, show its name, a traditional use and a safety note. Make poisonous plants show a red DANGER screen.
Ask Gemini for traditional uses in simple words, and check them with an elder or your science teacher.
Add the line 'For illness, see a doctor' on every screen.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student in a Telangana village. In simple English and Telugu, give one traditional home use for Tulsi, Neem, Doddapatre (Karpooravalli) and Aloe vera, and a safety warning for Datura and Jilledu. Add a reminder to see a doctor for real illness.
